en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a European city, showing a cobblestone avenue lined with mid‑rise stone and brick buildings. On the left is a large bank building with the word "PANKKI" above the entrance and a circular emblem on the wall. On the right is another substantial masonry building with bold exterior columns and signage high on the facade. Vintage cars and a few pedestrians occupy the street. In the lower right corner, the printed caption reads "KOTKA".
